protocol.training_selection: Use separate dev set; never tune on hidden outcomes. Hidden set is final evidence only.
protocol.metrics: Raw correct/total by kind and mode; untold includes invented-answer count; unrelated includes base-to-LoRA regressions.
protocol.generation_isolation: Generator reads pack.json only, never sealed/. Similarity auditor runs after generation and may reject but never rewrite hidden tests.
protocol.recommendation: Exploratory: report all counts. No learning claim without base and LoRA inference on the same sealed questions. Retrieval must use the same base model and system prompt.
